vb_textbox.text: Hello,This is what I believe I learnt from playing the game myself.I believe I had better results and earned more mushrooms when I selected the gnomes with the small green hat when it was next to a tall brown hat. Likewise, I also believe my results were more consistently better when selecting the gnome with the tall purple hat over the short red hat.The amount of mushrooms tends to fluctuate and I think I noticed if the numbers dropped I had better luck choosing the opposite of the above until the number increased and then switched back to the above method. I wish you well and hope you have luck with your game.Happy mushroom picking.
